facts.fact: The World Bank status report of 18 March 2026 lists the adoption of a national digital economy policy and strategy with a gender and disability lens in Guinea (and The Gambia) as a target of the WARDIP policy indicator, and its progress count shows entries for Guinea-Bissau, Mauritania and The Gambia but none for Guinea.
